about_the_game:
Operation Dartness

You awaken in a strange world still infused with the faded glories of the Soviet era. There’s only one way out: playing darts… but here, the rules have changed!

Welcome to Operation Dartness, a unique roguelike blending strategy and precision.

A roguelike based on darts!

You know the drill: rack up absurd scores to satisfy the Party, because failure is not an option.

Experiment with hundreds of synergies, upgrade your darts, manipulate the target, and discover wild effects that will completely transform your runs. Collect cryptic trinkets and indulge in all kinds of alcoholic beverages… in moderation, of course.

A world we miss.

Don’t you? Immerse yourself in a tavern filled with communist warmth and let a sarcastic companion guide you—always ready to comment on your triumphs… and naturally, your failures.

You’re here for a reason, one that for now seems far beyond your understanding.

Short runs, infinite replayability.

With runs lasting under 30 minutes, simple gameplay, and nearly endless upgrade possibilities, this game suits both hardcore roguelike veterans and new comrades eager to try their hand at darts.

Ready to aim true? Experience Operation Dartness.

content_descriptors.notes: The game features excessive alcohol drinking.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 280
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
